title: RimWorld: Contrarian, Ridiculous, and Impossible Game Design Methods
summary: RimWorld creator Tynan Sylvester explains at GDC 2017 how Ludeon framed the game as a story generator rather than a game. He covers the design methods that came out of that frame.
why: Recommended as an accessible talk on emergent narrative and on how RimWorld was designed, and cited in threads on simulation games.

quote.text: Strong recommend, if only to understand how RimWorld was designed and built.
